solver_notes: Deterministic two-thread native C11 regression executed on the RAK Miner v2 aarch64 host. A stalled consumer observes A/B; the other consumer performs pop A, pop B, push recycled A (A->C->A). Legacy pointer-only CAS succeeds and incorrectly installs B (corruption reproduced). The fixed head is {pointer,64-bit epoch}; stale A/epoch CAS is rejected, the CAS loop reloads pointer+generation, retries, and installs C with final_epoch=5. Statically owned nodes isolate ABA semantics; safe memory reclamation is explicitly out of scope. Runtime __atomic_is_lock_free(16)=0 on Cortex-A72: the 128-bit tagged CAS is provided by libatomic and is NOT claimed lock-free on this silicon. This is a standalone native model, not a claimed patch to python/cpython (which has no lockless_queue.c upstream target here). Issue 0045 repeats 0041's exact invariant and problem statement modulo issue id, so the proven source was intentionally reused and freshly compiled/re-run for 0045; no prior test result is inherited.
